{{Quote|Major Nedecca. I served under Darth Gravus on Taris and Rabaan.|Nedecca|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Nedecca''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] she served under [[Darth Gravus]] in the [[invasion of Taris]], this collaboration later continued as she accompanied him and his forces to [[Rabaan]]. By [[3640 BBY]] she was assigned to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Razer]]. She participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]] offensives such as an assault on the [[Aegis Base]] together with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sanos]] and former Intelligence Agent [[Cipher Nine]].
